message: 若さ故の過ち

name: Ria
message: 「Everyone was so fired up at the mixer...」

name: Ria
message: 「Looks like we're slowly getting the hang of Student Council work?」

name: Ria
message: 「I'd be happy if they keep working hard from here on out.」

name: Ria
message: 「Hehe...」

name: Macaron
message: 「Hey.」

name: Ria
message: 「Hyah!?」

name: Macaron
message: 「You there, big-boobed big sis.」

name: Ria
message: 「Huh? B-Big-boobed... m-me?」

name: Macaron
message: 「I-It's not like I'm jealous or envious or anything at all, okay!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Anyway, got a sec?」

name: Ria
message: 「W-What is it?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Where's Ryuusei Academy? Aah, I know it's around here, though!」

name: Ria
message: 「If you mean the academy, it's right there. Look.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Huh, ah, ohh, just as I thought!」

name: Ria
message: 「Are you... lost, by any chance?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Big sis.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Don't think you're superior to me just because you've got huge boobs, okay!」

name: Ria
message: 「Whaaat!? I-I don't think that at all...」

name: Ria
message: 「Besides, I wish you wouldn't say stuff like that so loudly...」

name: Macaron
message: 「Well, whatever! As long as I know where it is, we're good!」

name: Ria
message: 「Could it be you're looking for someone?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Well, something like that.」

name: Ria
message: 「I see. If you'd like, I can help you?」

name: Macaron
message: 「No thank you!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Someone of Lady Macaron's caliber can't let a little thing like getting lost get her down!」

name: Macaron
message: 「So because of that, I'll figure it out on my own.」

name: Ria
message: 「So your name is Macaron-chan. You're not a student at the academy, are you?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Yeah, I'm not. Is there a problem?」

name: Ria
message: 「U-umm...」

name: Ria
message: 「T-the person you're looking for, is it a friend?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Well, sort of. Though we do have a pretty deep relationship.」

name: Ria
message: 「Eh! By that, do you mean dating someone older, or...」

name: Ria
message: 「No, no! That's way too soon for you, Macaron-chan!」

name: Macaron
message: 「...What are you talking about?」

name: Ria
message: 「Huh? Ah, umm, well...」

name: Macaron
message: 「Oh well, whatever! Thanks for telling me, big sis.」

name: Ria
message: 「Ah, wait!」

name: Macaron
message: 「See ya!」

name: Ria
message: 「Oh my, she's fast.」

name: Ria
message: 「Somehow, she seemed like a super energetic kid...」

name: Ria
message: 「Or rather, are kids these days pretty precocious...?」
